title: Teamwork
subtitle: Teamwork = people working together effectively towards a shared goal. 它可以強調 共同協作、合力完成任務、互相
description: Teamwork = people working together effectively towards a shared goal. 它可以強調 共同協作、合力完成任務、互相配合、整隊共同成果、角色協調、集體投入，或單純『一起工作』的過程。

words.example: The project succeeded because of close collaboration between the design and engineering teams.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目成功，有賴設計和工程團隊之間的緊密協作。

exercises.original: Good teamwork between the writers and designers improved the final product.
exercises.zh: 編寫團隊與設計團隊的良好合作改善了最終成品。
exercises.upgrade: Close collaboration between the writers and designers improved the final product.

options.explanation: Collaboration ✓ — working with others to achieve a shared result, often by combining different skills or ideas。本句關鍵是 different specialist contributions are integrated；因此 Collaboration 最精準。
Cooperation — working together willingly and constructively towards a shared aim。cooperation 強調願意配合，可跨團隊／跨機構；若句子突出共創、明確 team achievement 或同步分工，另有更精準詞。
Team effort — work or effort contributed by members of a team towards a shared goal。team effort 聚焦整隊共同投入完成某項成果；若句子重點是跨機構合作或長期協作方式，會較窄。
Friendship — a relationship of mutual affection。friendship 是人際關係；朋友關係好不代表一定有有效 teamwork。
Communication — exchange of information or ideas。communication 是 teamwork 的重要部分，但只涵蓋訊息交換。
Leadership — the act or ability of leading。leadership 是帶領團隊的角色／能力，不是團隊合作本身。

exercises.zh: 這項研究有賴三所大學之間的協作。
exercises.upgrade: The research depended on collaboration across three universities.

Partnership — a relationship in which people or organisations work together。partnership 是合作關係的結構，不等於實際 teamwork 品質。

exercises.original: The students learned teamwork while completing the group task.
exercises.zh: 學生在完成小組任務時學會一起合作。
exercises.upgrade: The students learned the value of working together while completing the group task.

options.explanation: Collaboration — working with others to achieve a shared result, often by combining different skills or ideas。collaboration 很接近 teamwork，但更強調共同工作和整合不同貢獻；若只講配合或單一成果，另有更精準詞。
Working together ✓ — people combining their work or actions to achieve something together。本句關鍵是 verb-like process rather than abstract noun is intended；因此 Working together 最精準。
Cooperation — working together willingly and constructively towards a shared aim。cooperation 強調願意配合，可跨團隊／跨機構；若句子突出共創、明確 team achievement 或同步分工，另有更精準詞。

exercises.upgrade: Working together well made the whole process less stressful.

falseSynonyms.zh: 友誼 ≠ teamwork 關係友好不代表能有效合作完成任務。
溝通 ≠ teamwork 溝通是 teamwork 的一部分，但不是 teamwork 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Communication is one component.

falseSynonyms.zh: 領導 ≠ teamwork 領導可以促進 teamwork，但不是團隊合作本身。
廣義近義詞但不完全相同 cooperation 可以跨團隊／跨機構，不必有 team identity。
只在共同工作／共創 sense 高度接近 collaboration 強調共同產出與整合貢獻。
協調 ≠ teamwork coordination 只是把行動／時間安排配合好。
夥伴關係 ≠ teamwork partnership 是關係結構，不等於實際合作表現。
詞性陷阱 team 是名詞／動詞；teamwork 是不可數名詞。
